rows.title: Cash now at the lower of balance and available
rows.defect: the posted balance is used even when pending charges have lowered what is available
rows.test: checking counts at $3,950.00 available, not $4,000.00

rows.title: Payday every 14 days from deposits
rows.defect: the every-14-days schedule steps 15 days
rows.test: the next payday is Oct 16

rows.title: Twice a month, paid the Friday before a weekend
rows.defect: a deposit before its pay day is never matched to it (no weekend shift)
rows.test: the 15th and the last day fit though Aug 15 was paid Aug 14

rows.title: Twice a month, projected to the Friday before a weekend
rows.defect: a pay day on a weekend is projected on the weekend
rows.test: Oct 31 2026 (a Saturday) is expected Oct 30

rows.title: Every 14 days vs twice a month
rows.defect: the schedule with more exact deposits no longer wins
rows.test: a holiday-early deposit keeps the 14-day schedule

rows.title: Bills due on or before payday
rows.defect: a bill due on payday itself is left out
rows.test: the insurance due on payday (Oct 16) is subtracted

rows.title: A late bill is still expected
rows.defect: any bill whose date passed is dropped
rows.test: the Oct 9 phone bill, not posted, counts today

rows.title: A pending bill is not counted twice
rows.defect: pending charges are ignored, so the bill is subtracted from an available balance it already left
rows.test: a pending Mock Wireless charge removes that bill

rows.title: A stopped charge is left out
rows.defect: a charge that stopped months ago is still expected
rows.test: nothing since June: not a bill

rows.title: Per day rounded down to the cent
rows.defect: per day is rounded to the nearest cent, so it can add up to more than the total
rows.test: $1,000.02 over 4 days is $250.00 a day

rows.title: No payday: 30 days, labelled
rows.defect: the fallback window is 14 days
rows.test: the fallback is the next 30 days

rows.title: Renewals on the upcoming list
rows.defect: yearly and quarterly charges are listed as ordinary bills
rows.test: the yearly cloud storage charge is a renewal

rows.title: Runway leaves transfers out
rows.defect: money moved to the person's own savings counts as spending
rows.test: the transfer to savings is not spending

rows.title: Runway in whole days, rounded down
rows.defect: runway is rounded to the nearest day, so it can promise a day that isn't there
rows.test: 73.9 days of cash is 73 days

rows.title: Yes now only within safe to spend
rows.defect: affordability today is checked against cash, ignoring bills due before payday
rows.test: $5,900.00 is over the $5,785.00 safe to spend

rows.title: Affordability counts everyday spending
rows.defect: everyday spending is left out of the future, so the room is overstated
rows.test: what's left after the trip matches the forecast less everyday spending

rows.title: Unknown types listed apart
rows.defect: an account with no type is counted as owned
rows.test: the untyped joint account is not counted

rows.title: Forecast subtracts bills
rows.defect: bills are never subtracted from the projected balance
rows.test: the end equals start plus in minus out; the low is after the gym bill

rows.title: Show the math for the answer just given
rows.defect: a net worth answer is not recognized, so a bare "show me the math" after it goes unanswered
rows.test: a bare ask after a net worth answer explains net worth

rows.title: Other currencies never added into dollars
rows.defect: a euro balance is added into the dollar cash total
rows.test: the euro account is not cash

rows.title: A stale balance is said
rows.defect: a balance is called stale only after a week
rows.test: a balance 3 days old gets a heads-up

rows.title: A bare number after afford
rows.defect: only $-amounts and 'dollars' are read, so the ask goes to the model
rows.test: 'afford a 900 trip' is $900.00

rows.title: Days are not dollars
rows.defect: the unit guard is dropped, so '2 week' is $2.00
rows.test: 'afford a 2 week trip' reads no amount
